notes: Answers: owner_info and officer_member_info take one person per line (or ';'), 'Name, Title, SSN or Foreign, CA driver license' (SSNs are never written; 'Foreign' is). physical_location and mailing_address: 'street[, unit], city, ST ZIP' on the first line and the phone on the next line (or after ';'); only the first location fits, and the street goes whole into the Street Name box (Street # stays blank, there is no pick for 'all but the first word'). mailing_address 'Same as above' ticks that box. contact_person: 'Name, phone, email, relation, address'; declarant: 'Name, title, phone' (the signature and its date are left for the signer). 'Update Employer Account Information' ticks a box only when the answer names what changes (address, DBA, personal name, or officer/partner/member); industry 'Other (Specify): text' writes the text.
